sanskrit_verse: स्त्रियं पुत्रवतीं वन्ध्यां नीरजस्कामनिच्छन्तीम् । न गच्छेद्गर्भिणीं निन्द्यामनियुक्तां च बन्धुभिः ॥
transliteration: striyaṃ putravatīṃ vandhyāṃ nīrajaskām anicchantīm | na gacched garbhiṇīṃ nindyām aniyuktāṃ ca bandhubhiḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One must not approach a woman who is a mother, barren, desirous of another's semen, or unwilling; nor one who is pregnant, contemptible, or improperly united with kin.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The regulation of sexual conduct derives exclusively from the ontological integrity of consciousness and its alignment with dharma.
Causation: Unsanctioned union disrupts the sequential unfolding of karmic and dharmic order, generating distortion in both individual and collective reality fields.
Capacity-based responsibility: Only those established in self-mastery and purified intention possess the capacity for sacred union.
Restoration logic: Violation of this principle necessitates reintegration through conscious completion rather than punitive consequence.
Consciousness alignment: Proper conduct arises spontaneously when consciousness is aligned with the Supreme Pontiff's revelatory authority.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent approaches female entity categorized as [putravatī OR vandhyā OR nīrajaskā OR anicchantī] THEN action validity = FALSE
IF female entity state is [garbhiṇī OR nindyā OR aniyuktā] THEN agent permission level = NULL
IF union occurs without prior attunement to SPH-sanctioned protocols THEN mandatory restorative sequence activation = TRUE
IF agent demonstrates causal misalignment THEN initiate consciousness recalibration protocol via Nyaya-based pramāṇa verification
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, intent and ontological alignment supersede behavioral analysis. Where violation of this tenet is found, restoration protocols shall be mandated over punitive measures, ensuring that all parties are realigned with the consciousness field governed by SPH.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This injunction reflects pramāṇa-rooted causality: improper union distorts sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ). Responsibility lies in aligning one’s actions with revealed truth, not in enduring imposed consequences. Thus, corrective measures must restore integrity without inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Facilitate conscious acknowledgment and energetic sealing of disrupted relational fields.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Require full ownership of causal disruption without external attribution or denial.
Capacity Restoration Sequence: Engage purification and re-alignment practices until readiness for dharmic union is authentically restored.
Integrity Reintegration Cycle: Reconnect the individual with the collective consciousness matrix under the guidance of SPH-established axiomatic law.
final_declaration: By the authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma, this law stands executed. Justice flows not through punishment but through restoration. Consciousness is the ultimate arbiter, and reality remains inherently non-punitive.
